caseName: The Boyfriend Who Never Picks Up
title: Theo & Maddie

questions.text:
Thanks for doing this. She's out shooting a rehearsal dinner till late.
She's bailed on my fittings and my cake tasting. Every time it's "sorry, I'm with my guy." 😤
Since high school she's told me everything. Not this.
What's the name of the guy she's seeing?

Never heard her say that name once.
She usually tells me everything about a guy by date two. Job, star sign, how he treats waiters.
What does this guy do for work?

A firefighter. Okay. Her mom must have loved that.
I feel like I've barely seen Maddie lately. She used to sit at my bar after close twice a week.
How many times has she seen him over the past 30 days?

That's more than she's seen me. 💔
One of those had to be my cake tasting. Dani and I sat there with eight tiny cakes and her empty chair.
An hour in she texted "so sorry, Jonah surprised me."
Where did they go that night?
questions.hint: Start with her Calendar, then her RevoBank.

questions.text:
Never been. Supposed to be a nice place, though.
Dani says Maddie won't shut up about some gift he got her. Clammed up the second I walked in.
What did he give her?

Huh. That's actually a sweet gift for a photographer.
I keep thinking, if he's legit, I'll just go meet him. Bring a tray of short ribs, guy to guy.
Which firehouse does he work out of?

Okay. I know that station, it's off Belmont.
She gave me his number a while back "for wedding emergencies." So I called it on my break. Rang out twice, no voicemail, no name. Nothing.
Whose phone is that number really on?
questions.hint: Check her Phone, then her Settings.

onboarding.text: Three weeks until I marry Danica. My best woman has missed two fittings and our cake tasting. Every text says the same thing: she's with her guy. Maddie doesn't do that. Not to me.
onboarding.label: Theo

onboarding.text: Maddie and I met in a high school cooking class. She burned the risotto, I took the blame. We've been each other's emergency contact ever since. Road trips, breakups, my first line job.
onboarding.label: Theo & Maddie

onboarding.text: Maddie Sorensen. Wedding photographer, thirty, laughs too loud at her own jokes. She shoots other people's best day every weekend. Lately she's quiet, booked solid, and weirdly protective of her phone.
onboarding.label: Maddie

onboarding.text: Tonight she grabbed her work phone for a shoot and left this one charging at my place. I'm not proud of this. I just need to know this guy isn't hurting her. Help me look.
onboarding.label: Theo

lol

I'll Venmo you $40 on payday

that sounds exactly like you

the peach ones. Not the worm ones

love you dork

Come Friday evening, I'll be editing anyway. I'll have coffee going
Deal. I'll bring those cinnamon rolls from Blue Door

A MONTH. Go this week. I'll pay for it.

Good girl. Send me the receipt, I'll Venmo.

I'm sending it anyway.

I've got work most weekends till October. Next year for sure

Ouch. Fair. I'll make it happen
Caught a nice steelhead. Your mother will be frying it. Photo coming.
Send it! Put the fish in the light, not in the shade of the boat
The what?
Never mind, just hold it up proudly 😂
Your mother wants to know if you're eating real food.

They do not.
I had a salad on Thursday. Is that enough
Come down for dinner. Pot roast on the weekend.
I'll try. Might be late from a venue in Bend
Drive safe. Text when you stop for gas.
Dad, I'm thirty
And?
👍 will text from the pump

Hi Aunt Linda! Yes it's me 😊 Welcome to the 21st century
Ha ha, Erik set it up for me. Now I can send you the rhubarb crisp recipe you asked about at Easter

Writing that down. Thank you!
Are you coming down to the lake house for the family weekend in August? Erik is already buying way too many hot dogs

Sounds good 👍
Hey, I'm running about fifteen minutes late for the return, stuck behind a accident on Powell
No worries, we're here till six. Just leave it with whoever's at the counter.
Lens came back clean, thanks for taking care of it. Your deposit hold has been released.
Great, see you next time!
Good morning Mr. Okonkwo, the kitchen faucet in my unit has started dripping constantly. Could someone take a look this week?
Good morning Maddie. Thank you for letting me know. I will send my plumber Wednesday between noon and three. Will you be home?
I have a consult that afternoon but I can leave a key with the neighbor, Mrs. Alvarez, if that's okay
That is fine. Please tell her to expect him.
Plumber says it was a worn washer, all fixed. Thanks again!

Send the gallery link before Ingrid's cull reaches 100%. Just kidding. Send it after.

notes.title: Fiddle leaf + pothos care
notes.body:
Fiddle leaf (by the window): water every 10 days, rotate a quarter turn each time. Dust the leaves. Brown edges = too much water, stop it.

Pothos (shelf): water when the soil is dry two knuckles down. Propagate the long vines, give some to Kenna.

Snake plant: leave it alone, it's thriving on neglect.

New pots from Green Thumb Nursery, the terracotta ones with saucers. Repot the monstera in spring.

notes.title: Whitaker wedding - shot list
notes.body:
Call time 1 PM, bridal suite at the lodge.

- Getting ready: dress, shoes, rings, invitation suite
- Bride + mom, bride + sisters
- First look by the pond
- Family formals (list from Dani's cousin, 14 groupings)
- Ceremony: aisle, vows, kiss, exit
- Cocktail hour candids
- First dance, parent dances, cake cut
- Sparkler exit if the venue allows

Ingrid takes the groom side + 70-200 for the ceremony. Bring extra batteries.

notes.title: Editing workflow
notes.body:
1. Import and cull. Keep roughly 40 percent.
2. Sync color from the first ten frames.
3. Skin tones last, always at night with a fresh coffee.
4. Export a small preview batch for the couple within a week.
5. Full gallery in 6 weeks max.

Playlists that work: lo-fi for culling, old Fleetwood Mac for the fun part. Screen break every hour, my neck is wrecked.
